criteria.requirement: Add real csvkit.utilities.csvslice.CSVSlice and python -m entry using CSVKitUtility reader/writer conventions. Support zero-based nonnegative --start/--stop and positive --step (exclusive stop) through lazy islice, or mutually compatible --tail N through bounded deque, with tail=0 emitting only header. Preserve complete quoted/multiline records, dialect/encoding/skip/headerless options and exactly one header. Reject negative ranges, zero step and combined tail/range modes before output, support empty/header-only inputs and never preload ordinary forward slices.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
